about: Golden vectors of the CPC firmware maths entries, recorded on CPCEC (headless) through the real Locomotive interpreter's ROMs by tools/fwm-record.py. REALs are 5 bytes in Locomotive's layout as hex (mantissa LS byte first, exponent last). Inputs are shared by the models; results are per model, '=6128' meaning identical to the 6128 list.
